entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, about time. I bought this jersey from you and it's a piece of junk. I want to return it right now.

I'm sorry to hear that you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

A preference issue? Are you kidding me? Your sizing chart is a complete lie! I ordered a large, and this thing is so ridiculously tight I can barely get it on. This is your company's fault, not my 'preference'. I need to exchange this for the right size, and I need to do it now.

I understand your frustration, and I apologize that the sizing wasn't what you expected. It sounds like you received the wrong size for your needs. Let me just pull up your order information, and I can definitely help you with that exchange.

You'd better. This is completely unacceptable. If I don't get a return label in my inbox in the next five minutes, I'm writing a review on every single website I can find. I want to speak to your manager!

There's no need to speak to a manager, I can absolutely handle this for you right now. I see your order right here from nine days ago. Since the jersey is a standard apparel item, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy. I'm processing that for you as we speak.
So you can actually do it? Are you sure?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the exchange for you. You'll be receiving a pre-paid return label in your email shortly so you can send back the jersey that's too tight. As soon as we see that the return has been scanned by the carrier, we'll ship out the larger size to you. Does that sound good?
Fine. Yes. That works. Make sure it's an XL this time.
I've confirmed the exchange is for an XL. The email with all the instructions is on its way to you now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and we hope you enjoy your new jersey.
